title: Declared test commands can't express a negative test filter (`!=`), because `!` is outside the line allow-list
outcome: A declared dotnet test command can carry a negative filter such as --filter 'TestCategory!=Slow' inside a single-quoted word, judged safe for both bash and pwsh, or the docs keep stating the limitation with the supported alternatives (a positive filter or a runsettings file).
acceptance: Declared test commands can't express a negative test filter (`!=`), because `!` is outside the line allow-list is done
